rules.body-size: QFN/QFP by terminal family, lead count and explicit body WxL; pitch and exposed pad are not compared.
rules.chip-imperial: Two-terminal chip by EIA imperial code; footprint library fixes the component class.
rules.gull-wing: SOIC/TSSOP by lead count with the JEDEC body width, length and pitch for that name.
rules.named-sot23: SOT-23 outline by explicit name and lead count; lead counts are never crossed.
